t-shirt-de-bende.title: T-shirt De Bende
t-shirt-de-bende.description: White T-shirt with the De Dolle Brouwers characters: Oerbier, Arabier, Stille Nacht, Boskeun and Dulle Teve, drawn by Kris Herteleer.

crewneck-grijs.title: Grey crewneck
crewneck-grijs.description: Grey crewneck from De Dolle Brouwers, with the brewery in Esen on the back.

trui-zwart.title: Black hoodie
trui-zwart.description: Black hoodie with the De Dolle Brouwers logo in yellow on the back. With or without zip.

pet.title: Oerbier figure cap
pet.description: Black cap with the Oerbier figure embroidered.

oerbier-mannetje.title: Oerbier figure
oerbier-mannetje.description: The yellow Oerbier figure as a statuette, with brewer's fork and glass.

oerbier-mannetje-op-maat.title: Your own Oerbier figure
oerbier-mannetje-op-maat.description: Your own Oerbier figure: pick the colours, a flag or logo, and the text on the scarf. Put it together on our site; we make it by hand.

metalen-bord.title: Metal sign
metalen-bord.description: Metal sign with one of the De Dolle Brouwers beers.

oeral-glas.title: Oeral glass
oeral-glas.description: The Oeral glass, 25 cl, with the little plane from the Oeral drawing and the stars.

oerbier-glas-klein.title: Small Oerbier glass
oerbier-glas-klein.description: The small stemmed Oerbier glass, with the Oerbier figure and "Nat en straf".

cadeaubon-50.title: €50 gift voucher, drawn by Kris
cadeaubon-50.description: A €50 gift voucher, drawn and painted by hand by Kris Herteleer. This is not a code in your inbox: we post you the real, hand-drawn voucher, or you pick it up in the Oerbar. A nice present for Father's Day, a birthday or just because. Valid until the end of time, but preferably before.

affiches-set.title: Set of 6 posters
affiches-set.description: Six classic De Dolle Brouwers posters, drawn by Kris Herteleer: Oerbier with the cave drawing, the black Oerbier, Arabier, Dulle Teve, Stille Nacht and Special Export Stout. We ship them together, rolled up in a tube, so we only sell them as a set (€5 per poster).

hidden-beers-of-belgium.title: Book Hidden Beers of Belgium
hidden-beers-of-belgium.description: Hidden Beers of Belgium by Breandán Kearney, with photographs by Ashley Joanna and a foreword by Rob Tod (Luster, 2024). The book seeks out 24 lesser-known but extraordinary Belgian beers: how they are made, why they taste the way they do, the people behind them and where to drink them. De Dolle Brouwers is in it too. Hardcover, in English.

garbage-pail-kids-taste-buds.title: Garbage Pail Kids Taste Buds
garbage-pail-kids-taste-buds.description: Garbage Pail Kids Taste Buds, Series One (Topps, 2022): a sealed pack with 10 sticker cards and 1 parallel. In this series twenty craft brewers from around the world became a Garbage Pail Kid, and Kris is in it as Crafted Kris (card 2a). Only 3,342 packs were made. Every pack is random: with a bit of luck, you pull Kris.
